title: [CLM-10] S3 forbids IOs holding exporter outputs, but `channelToken` is one
description: Review finding CLM-10: S3 forbids IOs holding exporter outputs, but `channelToken` is one (lens CLM). Location: ARCHITECTURE.md:96-99; spec/14-jmap.md:124; spec/05-messaging.md:194. Fix: As proposed. `channelToken` is `MLS-Exporter("agora channel token", ...)`, held by relays (§5 item 2) and sequencers (14.4.6 "the streams it orders (`channelToken`s)"). 14.4.1's "holds no ... exporter outputs" is literally false. S3: "other than routing tokens and those derived for IO verification (§6.2)". 14.4.1: "no exporter outputs other than routing tokens". Full text: notes/review/CLM-verified.md and notes/review/CLM.md.
close_reason: MOOT per notes/review/reconciliation.md: channelToken is no longer an MLS exporter output: spec/05-messaging.md §5.2.2 Channel Admission derives it by HKDF from the CO-issued admission key seed; ARCHITECTURE.md S3 rewritten (IO holds registered admission public keys and routing tokens); 14-jmap.md §14.4.1 "no exporter outputs" now accurate
